provenance: Every source was reached. Controller, GlobalAir and AvPay were read from the cloud side; everything else, the FAA register and the one new photograph came through the browser pane on the Mac mini, which answered at 11:05 UTC and was signed in to Facebook throughout with no sign-in wall. Facebook Marketplace was searched at fourteen cities with four terms each and holds to about forty miles of each city; twenty-eight Facebook groups were searched with four terms each, 112 passes, and every candidate post not already in the record was opened to read its date. aerogurus, FindAircraft and the AircraftForSale list pages repeat inventory other sites carry, so nothing enters from them unless a primary advertisement confirms it. Three listings were not re-sighted this run and are flagged on the row rather than dropped; a listing leaves the record only when its advertisement is gone or after seven consecutive unsighted runs with no ad page.
